parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

😎
awhile[əˈwaɪl]adv.
If you do something awhile, you do it for a short time. (trong chốc lát)
→ Wait here awhile, and I’ll bring some tea.
😎
cyberspace[ˈsaɪbərspeɪs]n.
Cyberspace is the imaginary place of the Internet where activities occur. (không gian mạng)
→ I didn’t receive your email. It probably got lost in cyberspace.
😎
edit[ˈedɪt]v.
To edit means to correct a piece of writing so that it is suitable to be published. (chỉnh sửa)
→ She asked her brother to edit her paper before she submitted it to her teacher.
😎
essay[ˈeseɪ]n.
An essay is a short piece of writing on a certain subject. (bài luận)
→ She had to write a two-page essay for her English class.
😎
evaluate[ɪˈvæljueɪt]v.
To evaluate something means to study it, so a decision can be made. (đánh giá)
→ Joe and Ken evaluated the plan and agreed that it would work.
😎
faint[feɪnt]v.
To faint means to go unconscious and fall down. (ngất xỉu)
→ Carol fainted because she hadn’t eaten in over a day.
😎
global[ˈɡloʊbl]adj.
If something is global, it happens all around the world. (toàn cầu)
→ Pollution is a global problem.
😎
gymnasium[dʒɪmˈneɪziəm]n.
A gymnasium is a building with equipment that you can use to get exercise. (phòng thể dục)
→ When I go to the gymnasium, I use the treadmill for 20 minutes.
😎
highlight[ˈhaɪlaɪt]v.
To highlight something means to mark it with a color so that it is easy to see. (làm nổi bật)
→ I read my vocabulary list and highlighted the most difficult words.
😎
ignorant[ˈɪɡnərənt]adj.
If someone is ignorant about something, they have no knowledge about it. (thiếu hiểu biết)
→ I’m a bit ignorant about his theories. Can you explain them to me?
😎
index[ˈɪndeks]n.
An index is a list of words at the end of a book that gives information. (bảng chỉ mục (cuối sách))
→ If you look in the index, you’ll find the right page number.
😎
lecture[ˈlektʃər]n.
A lecture is a long, educational speech. (bài giảng)
→ His lecture on world hunger was very informative.
😎
moral[ˈmɔːrəl]n.
A moral is a message at the end of a story that teaches you something. (bài học đạo đức)
→ At the end of the story, Mother explained the moral to the children.
😎
operate[ˈɑːpəreɪt]v.
To operate means to work or function. (vận hành / hoạt động)
→ I’m sorry, but the trains are not operating today.
😎
private[ˈpraɪvət]adj.
If something is private, it is only used by one person or group. (riêng tư)
→ Don’t look at my diary! It’s private!
😎
recent[ˈriːsnt]adj.
When something is recent, it happened a short time ago. (gần đây)
→ I did not know what caused his recent behavior.
😎
resolution[ˌrezəˈluːʃn]n.
A resolution is a personal decision. (sự quyết tâm / quyết định)
→ At New Year, I made a list of resolutions to help me have a better year.
😎
semester[sɪˈmestər]n.
A semester is a portion of a school year. (học kỳ)
→ Jack is in his second semester of college.
😎
typewritten[ˈtaɪprɪtn]adj.
If something is typewritten, it is written on a computer or typewriter. (được đánh máy)
→ This is an important, formal project and must be typewritten.
😎
weird[wɪrd]adj.
When something is weird, it is very strange. (kỳ lạ)
→ My best friend’s dad is a bit weird.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Magic Computer

I had a difficult geography project to finish by the end of the semester. My teacher wanted it to be typewritten, so I went to the school computer room. But when I got there, all the computers were turned off. Apparently there was a recent problem, and technicians were fixing it.

I knew of some private study rooms downstairs. They were small and dark, and the computers were very old, but I had no choice. At least the computers were operating correctly. I typed and highlighted the assignment’s title: “Evaluate the Government’s Response to Global Warming.” But I didn’t know what to write in my essay. Finally I decided to find a book to help me. I went to the library, checked the book indexes and eventually found a useful book. Then I returned to the computer.

When I looked at the screen, I saw something so weird that I nearly fainted! The essay was complete! Had somebody in cyberspace written it? I didn’t know, but I was very happy. I printed it out and handed it in. I got an “A.”

After that, I used the computer for all my assignments. I’d type the title, wait awhile, and the computer would do it. Every assignment was perfect; I never had to edit anything. I stopped paying attention to my teacher’s lectures and spent my extra time in the gymnasium. And my grades got better and better.

A month later, I was walking into class when my friend said, “Are you prepared for the test?”

“What test?” I asked.

“The geography test!” he replied. “I hope you studied. It’s worth seventy percent of our final grade!”

I failed the test, of course. I was completely ignorant about the subject.

After that, I made a resolution never to use the magic computer again. The moral of this story is that if you cheat at school, you won’t learn anything.

questions.content: The computers were turned off because there was a recent problem.
questions.explanation: Đúng (True). 'Apparently there was a recent problem, and technicians were fixing it.'

questions.content: The private study rooms were upstairs.
questions.explanation: Sai (False). The private study rooms were downstairs.

questions.content: The computers in the private study rooms weren't operating correctly.
questions.explanation: Sai (False). The computers in the private study rooms were operating correctly.

questions.content: In his project, the student had to evaluate the government's response to global warming.
questions.explanation: Đúng (True). 'I typed and highlighted the assignment’s title: “Evaluate the Government’s Response to Global Warming.”'

questions.content: The geography test was worth fifty percent of the final grade.
questions.explanation: Sai (False). The geography test was worth seventy percent of the final grade.

questions.content: The student failed the test because he was completely ignorant about the subject.
questions.explanation: Đúng (True). 'I failed the test, of course. I was completely ignorant about the subject.'
